scheme_name_en: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana - accident claim
channels: The bank branch where the PMSBY premium was auto-debited
failure_consequence_kn: 30 ದಿನಗಳೊಳಗೆ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕ್ಲೇಮ್ ವಿಳಂಬ ಅಥವಾ ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ ಆಗಬಹುದು.
benefit_summary_kn: ಅಪಘಾತ ಮರಣ ಅಥವಾ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂಗವೈಕಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ 2 ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂ, ಭಾಗಶಃ ಅಂಗವೈಕಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ 1 ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂ.
verification_note: 30-day submission window widely stated across insurer and aggregator sources. Confirm against the current official Jan Suraksha claim procedure document before relying on it.
evidence_checklist_en: Collect the claim-cum-discharge form from the bank
FIR copy — mandatory for accident cases
Copy of the first two pages of the passbook
failure_consequence_en: If not submitted to the bank within 30 days the claim may be delayed or rejected.
required_documents_en: Death certificate, or disability certificate from a civil surgeon
FIR copy - mandatory for accident cases
Nominee's Aadhaar and bank account details
channels_en: The bank branch where the PMSBY premium was auto-debited
